patches_added.name: Fix videos that won't send
patches_added.description: Messenger stops two kinds of video with "Unable to send". One is a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. The other is a Samsung screen recording whose recorder tag Messenger's media check rejects. Whether you share one into Messenger from another app or pick it in a chat, the sound is converted to regular AAC, or the tag is dropped, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hold stories at the end
patches_added.description: Keeps a story on screen when it ends instead of moving on to the next one, so you go on with a tap or a swipe. Photos and videos both wait, and the last story stays open until you close it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Mark as read button
patches_added.description: Puts Messenger's Mark as read icon in a chat's top bar while Hide read receipts is on. Opening the chat still sends nothing, and a tap on the icon sends Seen and marks the chat read. It takes the place of the chat details button, since tapping the chat's name opens the same page, so the call buttons stay put. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_removed.name: Fix shared videos with xHE-AAC sound
patches_removed.description: Messenger can't send a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. Whether you share one into Messenger from another app or pick it in a chat, its sound is converted to regular AAC first, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels

Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Override certificate pinning
patches_modified.description: Allows HTTPS traffic inspection tools like AdGuard Premium to intercept app connections. Enables ViX live (Lura SSAI) ad suppression when used alongside AdGuard Premium. Security trade-off: the app will also trust ANY user-installed CA; turn it off if you don't use an HTTPS-filtering proxy.

patches_modified.previous_description: Suppresses ViX ad delivery by stopping the LuraPlayer linear ad-break scheduler (client-side VAST) and preventing the Innovid SSAI ad overlay from mounting.

patches_modified.name: Theme
patches_modified.description: Adds options to change the app's themes and splash screen style.
patches_modified.previous_description: Changes the app's themes to the values specified in patch options.

patches_modified.name: Toolbar components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide or change components located on the toolbar, such as the search bar, header, and toolbar buttons.

patches_modified.name: Translations for YouTube
patches_modified.description: Add translations or remove string resources.

patches_modified.name: Video playback
patches_modified.description: Adds options to customize settings related to video playback, such as default video quality and playback speed.

patches_modified.name: Visual preferences icons for YouTube
patches_modified.description: Adds icons to specific preferences in the settings.

patches_modified.name: Voice Over Translation
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to enable Yandex voice-over translation of video audio tracks.

patches_modified.name: Wide search bar
patches_modified.description: Adds a wide search bar to the top of the home and subscription feed.

patches_added.name: Disable pronunciation nag
patches_added.description: Removes the "device doesn't support pronunciation" toast and install-TTS dialog, and hides the pronunciation button when no usable TTS engine/language is available.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Pro
patches_modified.description: Forces the purchase check to always return true, unlocking Pro.

patches_modified.name: Clean SnapTube Settings Page
patches_modified.description: Hides the Download tools and Phone clean categories, and their sub-items, from Settings.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the Download tools and Phone clean categories, and their sub-items, from Settings.

patches_modified.name: Disable Annoying Snaptube Notifications
patches_modified.description: Turns off the Toolbar, Recommended contents, and Tool notifications channels by default.

patches_modified.name: Remove Watch Ad To Download
patches_modified.description: Removes the requirement to watch a rewarded ad before a download starts.

patches_modified.name: Remove from default browser list
patches_modified.description: Strips the LinkHandleActivity alias's unscoped so the app stops appearing as a candidate in the system's default browser / "open with" chooser.

patches_added.name: Long press to select tab range
patches_added.description: In tab tray selection mode, long press a second tab to select every tab between. Toggle in Mod Settings.

patches_added.name: Fix HLS seek playback
patches_added.description: Remuxes classic MPEG-TS HLS downloads to MP4 so seeking in players has no dark frames.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Pro
patches_modified.description: Signature verification is spoofed automatically if this patch is selected the purchase check passes.

patches_added.name: Remove Video Enhancer Animation
patches_added.description: Skips the Visual Enhancer enable animation and applies effects instantly without reloading the video. Toggle in Mod Settings.

patches_modified.name: MonkeyScript userscript manager
patches_modified.description: Adds the Chrome 150 Material You userscript manager and cloning. Trichrome builds need the matching original Trichrome Library APK installed before the patched Chrome APK.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a Chrome 150 Material You userscript manager using a Violentmonkey-derived parser, native app-menu integration, guaranteed Fork-page installation, Greasy Fork/Sleazy Fork support, publishing, and configurable app/package cloning.

patches_added.name: Universal Captions - additional translation languages
patches_added.description: Adds and alphabetizes native Auto-translate languages. Caption preferences remain managed by Morphe.

patches_removed.name: Universal Captions - unlock translation languages (experimental)
patches_removed.description: Adds YouTube-native auto-translation targets to Android captions menu. No AI or external translation API.

patches_added.name: Favorites random shortcut
patches_added.description: Show a one-tap random gallery button above the bottom navigation on the Favorites tab in Pupil 6.1.1.

patches_added.name: Hide reels by caption words
patches_added.description: Leaves out reels whose caption holds a word or phrase from your list. Starts off. Turn it on and type the words in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Show a reel's exact time
patches_modified.description: Adds the date and time a reel was posted under the author's name, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, with the seconds or how long ago (1d 2h 5m ago) if you want them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds the date and time a reel was posted under the author's name, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, with seconds if you want them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_added.name: Collection picker search
patches_added.description: Adds an option to show a search bar on the sheet where you pick the collection for a saved video, so you do not have to scroll through every collection.

patches_added.name: Liked videos search
patches_added.description: Adds an option to show a search bar on the liked videos page that filters loaded videos by description or creator.

patches_modified.name: Fix Navigation Bar Haze
patches_modified.description: Monitors the effective bottom tabs visibility for persistent navigation Haze.
patches_modified.previous_description: Diagnoses the bottom navigation container using a solid salmon background.

patches_modified.name: Fix Navigation Bar Haze
patches_modified.description: Monitors the effective bottom tabs visibility for persistent navigation Haze.
patches_modified.previous_description: Diagnoses the bottom navigation container using a solid salmon background.
